selection: Retain every eligible Pedestrian 0-2m camera and every eligible Vehicle/Pedestrian 0-1m camera, then deterministic six-cell round robin with recording-log fairness, preferring unused keyframes. Additional views of the same keyframe are allowed only for the mandatory rare-view retention. No predictions enter selection. Fail if mandatory views exceed the declared budget.
heldout_policy: Exclude all three previously inspected evaluation recording logs, without reassigning their original roles. Never include train or excluded Mini logs in this evaluation package.
reference: Original-resolution positive camera-axis Z in metres from single-sweep LiDAR. Use reviewed nearest-pixel z-buffer before semantic/range filtering, 5px/0.5m boundary guard and <=50ms sensor timing gate. Keep only conservative exact-semantic points unambiguously owned by an annotated Vehicle/Pedestrian box. A cell mask includes an object only when that object has >=5 such points in that camera/band. No interpolation into GT holes.
prediction_contract: One raw-metre positive camera-axis-Z prediction per saved GT point in the exact saved order. Record the model artifact SHA256 and preprocessing/sampling implementation before inference. Sample model output at the frozen original-image coordinates using a declared pixel-centre transform; no image-wise or test-set scale/shift fitting, no clamping predictions to the GT band, no dropping failed images.
primary_metric: Within each primary cell: mean absolute error over valid predicted points of each object-camera observation; equal cameras within an annotation/keyframe observation; equal observations within an instance track; equal tracks within a recording log; equal recording logs. Finally average the four primary cells equally. This conditional error must always be shown with prediction coverage; lower coverage is never silently treated as improvement.
supplementary_metrics: pointwise conditional mean absolute error in metres
pointwise conditional median absolute error in metres
pointwise conditional p90 absolute error in metres using linear quantiles
valid positive finite predictions / all frozen eligible GT points
reference and predicted object observations, instance tracks and recording logs per cell
paired_comparison: Use identical frozen samples and GT masks for V0/V1. Report each model on its own valid predictions plus paired errors on the intersection of both valid masks. Report both missing-prediction fractions and images. Never compare conditional error alone or interpret missing cells as zero error.
v0_v1_binding: This data-only package does not choose or bind model weights. Register immutable V0 and V1 artifact/preprocessing identities before inference; V0 is the unchanged baseline, V1 is the later trained candidate. Registration does not alter this benchmark.
weight_only_comparison_control: A claim that training improved the same model requires matching V0/V1 architecture, preprocessing and output-sampling identities. If any of these change, label the comparison as an architecture/runtime change rather than weight-only training improvement.
scope: GT-enriched engineering depth benchmark, not representative full nuScenes detection mAP, a 3D cuboid benchmark, ultrasonic nearest-surface truth, or product qualification. Label classes are GT-oracle classes for the depth metrics. Detection quality needs a separately validated camera-label protocol.
confidence: Repeated frames, views and tracks are correlated. Report recording-log support and exploratory-cell scarcity; future uncertainty estimates must cluster at recording-log level, not individual points.
